nodes.description: Transplantation replaces the patient's hematopoiesis with donor cells that carry two wild-type IKZF1 alleles, and is the only treatment that addresses the defect itself. Four patients with dominant-negative variants were reported in a dedicated transplant series: all achieved more than 99% donor chimerism, one died of liver failure about a year afterwards following earlier cryptosporidial cholangitis, and the survivors came off immunoglobulin replacement and antimicrobial prophylaxis. Because functionally defective monocytes contribute to the T-cell defect, the founding authors warn that lymphoid engraftment alone or mixed chimerism may not be enough.

nodes.description: The mutant dimerizes with wild-type IKAROS and reaches the nucleus, and when the two are co-expressed at mutant to wild-type ratios from 25:75 to 75:25 the number of wild-type IKAROS foci per nucleus falls, which a haploinsufficient mutant does not cause. The same interference is seen on AIOLOS. IKAROS represses its targets at pericentromeric heterochromatin through the NuRD complex, and in a reporter assay the dominant-negative variants fail to repress the IKAROS target HNRNPLL, so the result is a loss of IKAROS activity deeper than the half dose of haploinsufficiency. The authors propose that the mutant retains weak DNA binding with altered specificity, which would explain how it drags its partners off target, but that model is not established.

nodes.description: Most circulating T cells are naive and carry low-density CD45RA with a recent-thymic-emigrant phenotype, while central memory and effector memory cells are reduced. Patient T cells kept in culture after mitogen stimulation stay naive instead of becoming effector memory cells. Proliferation is poor in response to low-dose anti-CD3, to anti-CD3 plus anti-CD28 and to recall antigen, CD25 is not upregulated after stimulation and IL-2 does not rescue the defect, regulatory T cells are reduced, and production of interferon gamma, TNF, IL-4, IL-6 and IL-17A is impaired, so Th1, Th2 and Th17 polarization all fail. This naive-dominant picture is the opposite of the haploinsufficient and dimerization-defective classes, where memory cells accumulate.

nodes.description: The combined lymphoid and myeloid defect leaves patients unable to control opportunistic organisms. Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia occurred in every reported patient between six and twenty-four months of age, and most also had invasive bacterial respiratory infection, severe or recurrent viral infection, or fungal infection. The susceptibility is not uniform: live viral and BCG vaccines were given without complication, and chickenpox ran an uncomplicated course, which the authors attribute to preserved proliferation under strong stimulation and to normal interferon responses.
